code_fault_assessment.statement: The earlier one-dimensional phase-map and seam-derivative defects were repaired. The v6 isolated run now computes both two-dimensional branches point by point, and exact algebra, independent exponentiation, topology, adaptive convergence and seam tests exclude an implementation origin for the remaining convention conflict.

checks.statement: Both coefficient readings are explicit in the frozen config and output, with no hidden parameter fit.
The active manuscript definition and displayed Hamiltonian were audited directly, and no convention-resolving statement exists in the source archive.
Both full two-dimensional convention grids contain no unresolved numerical points; near-boundary points are adaptively refined and explicitly classified.
diag(delta,-delta) has onsite-energy difference 2 delta, whereas diag(delta/2,-delta/2) realizes the printed epsilon_A-epsilon_B definition.
Full-evolution winding, gauge-aware Fukui Chern and an independent general matrix-exponential product preserve the same phase ordering and equal-step evolution.
The v6 isolated runner read every declared input, denied no access, and never exposed raw or reference figures to the numerical process.
